summary: Iter29 backlog (chat moderation + scheduled site-switch + skeletons/empty-states) tested. Backend pytest 9/9 PASSING covering PATCH /api/admin/settings (set/clear maintenance_scheduled_on|off), scheduler _job_apply_scheduled_toggles flips maintenance_mode + clears schedule field, admin chat messages GET (auth gate + 401), DELETE (200 + 404 paths), per-channel mute POST/GET/DELETE with idempotency, and WS mute lookup structure (per-channel scope intact). Frontend Playwright: AdminDashboard 'Chat Mod' tab loads, all 5 channel chips render (general/wins/help/marketplace/makers-only), channel switching works, recent-messages container + manual-mute form + active-mutes list all render with data-testids. End-to-end manual-mute → list update → unmute flow verified live against backend. Settings tab Scheduled Maintenance card renders with 2 datetime-local inputs and Turn ON/OFF labels. Shop and Makers pages show data-testid='skeleton' shimmer during load; shimmer @keyframes defined.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by some duration option rendering. Cosmetic, no functional break.

Datetime-local inputs and the 'Clear schedule' button lack individual data-testids (maintenance-scheduled-on / maintenance-scheduled-off / maintenance-clear-schedule). The wrapper has data-testid='maintenance-schedule-card' but child controls are unaddressable for automation.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to the two datetime-local inputs in MaintenanceScheduleCard and to the Clear-schedule button (e.g., maintenance-scheduled-on / maintenance-scheduled-off / maintenance-clear-schedule) so the schedule-flip UI flow can be automated.

Investigate the React hydration warning in ChatModTab duration <select>: the option's child must be a plain text node, not a <span>. Search MUTE_PRESETS rendering / option label and replace any inline <span> with raw text.

Optional: spot-check MakerDashboard Orders/Products/Billing/Payouts skeleton + empty-state data-testids in a future iteration — those flows weren't reached in this run because they require maker auth and the listed UI is gated behind tab navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: scheduler.py _job_apply_scheduled_toggles: when both scheduled_on and scheduled_off times are in the past, the loop iterates in dict order so the second (off) wins — acceptable since admin should not schedule both fields in the past, but worth a comment in the code.

chat_mod.py POST /admin/chat/mute already lower-cases user_email via Pydantic EmailStr — frontend should mirror that lowercasing before display in active-mutes for visual consistency (already does via .toLowerCase() in submitManualMute, OK).

settings.py PATCH allows '' or null to clear scheduled timestamps; ISO format is not validated. A malformed ISO string would be caught only at the scheduler job (logged + cleared). Consider validating with datetime.fromisoformat at PATCH time so the admin gets immediate feedback.
test_credentials: Admin: team@craftersmarket.org via issue_admin_magic_token() — verified works end-to-end. Maker test slug iron-and-oak available but maker dashboard flows not exercised this run.
